parameters.query: WITH next_recipient AS (SELECT r.id FROM recipients r WHERE r.status='SELECTED' ORDER BY r.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE recipients r SET status='ENRICHING', claimed_at=now(), attempt_count=attempt_count+1 FROM next_recipient n WHERE r.id=n.id RETURNING r.id AS recipient_id,r.campaign_id,r.professor_name,r.professor_email,r.university,r.canonical_profile_url,r.research_interest,r.evidence_json;

SELECT r.*,c.full_name AS candidate_name,c.base_cv_object_key,c.transcript_object_key,cp.domain FROM recipients r JOIN campaigns cp ON cp.id=r.campaign_id JOIN candidates c ON c.id=cp.candidate_id WHERE r.id=$1 AND r.status='ENRICHING';

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.recipients
SET
  status = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED',
  draft_subject = $2,
  draft_html_body = $3,
  cv_summary = $4,
  tailored_cv_object_key = $5,
  template_version = $6,
  validation_status = 'PASSED',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1
  AND status = 'ENRICHING'
RETURNING id, status, tailored_cv_object_key;
